title: poa dura
intro: Poa dura, commonly known as Wild Quaking Grass, is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory problems, and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Poa dura include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Poa dura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
